verdict.rationale: Fastmail has a first-party help article titled "Templates", so a saved-template capability for composing appears to exist. The pack contains only the article title, with no detail on how templates are inserted, whether they support variables, or whether they can carry attachments. Missing for 10: documented template insertion workflow, variable/placeholder support, attachments in templates, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can insert saved snippets or templates — with variables and attachments — instead of retyping the same reply
